verdict.rationale: Spline exposes developer and agent surfaces (Code API, Real-time API, webhooks, MCP server), so a sandbox/test environment is a fair question, but the evidence shows none. The docs note the Real-time API Response preview and live webhook URL are in-editor conveniences 'without an isolated test environment'. The Code tab's 'sandboxed iframe' is browser rendering isolation, not a separate environment for testing against non-production data, and version history is a related but different feature; neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
